title: Jesus... Why Did They Pick Someone Else Again?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, why did they pick someone else again?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Third one this year. I stopped telling people I applied.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You stopped telling people because you were protecting yourself from their faces.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That is not weakness. That is a person who has been bruised learning where to stand.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It feels like there is a season for everyone except me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: There is a season for you. You are in one right now. You just do not like its name.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Preparing. Those look identical from inside.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: How long does this one last?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Longer than you want. Shorter than it feels. And you will not waste it, because I do not waste anything.

bible.text: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens:
